name: FreshBooks
whatYouLose: Card and bank payments with reconciliation
Tax reports your accountant already accepts
Automatic late-payment reminders that land in inboxes
prompt:
Build invoicing for a freelancer, a FreshBooks replacement.

Stack: Node + Hono, SQLite, server-rendered HTML, PDF via Playwright print-to-PDF.
Features:
- Clients, invoices with line items, taxes, discounts, currency per client, sequential numbering.
- Beautiful invoice PDF and a public invoice page /i/:token with a Stripe Payment Link button.
- Stripe webhook marks invoices paid; reminders emailed at due date and +7 days.
- Expenses with receipt upload and categories; simple P&L and tax-year summary report, CSV export for my accountant.
- Recurring invoices.
Done when: I create an invoice, pay it in Stripe test mode, and see it marked paid.
notes: Invoices are easy; money movement and accounting compliance are where you either keep paying or lean on Stripe.
